heading: INT. FARMHOUSE DINING ROOM, WHEAT HARVEST SUPPER - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FARMHOUSE DINING ROOM, WHEAT HARVEST SUPPER - NIGHT
A long pine table sags under platters of ham, corn, and pickled beets.
Kerosene lamps.
Outside, combines idle in the dark, still warm.
Six people sit shoulder to shoulder, and nobody has touched the food.
At the head of the table sits GRANDFATHER IVAR HALVORSEN (80s, overalls pressed for the occasion, a hearing aid whistling softly).
His son ARNE HALVORSEN (50s, sunburnt neck, silent) cuts bread with great deliberation.
Arne's wife GUNHILD (50s, hair pinned too tight) refills a water glass that is already full.
Across from them their daughter ASTRID (20s, city shoes, suitcase by the door) stares at her plate.

Beside her sits her younger brother LEIF (15, braces, a bruise under one eye), and at the foot of the table, farmhand RAMON BEAUMONT-CRUZ (30s, borrowed shirt, hat in lap) looks anywhere but at the family.
Arne finishes slicing.
The knife stays in his hand.
Pass the beets.
units.name: ARNE

units.text: Astrid passes the beets.
Her fingers shake.
Gunhild reaches, touches her daughter's wrist, and pulls back as if burned.
What's that?
units.name: IVAR

units.text: Nothing, Pa.
units.name: ARNE

units.text: What's she doing here?
units.name: IVAR

units.text: Eating supper.
units.name: ARNE

units.text: Leif knocks over the salt.
Nobody moves to clean it.
Ramon sets his hat on the table, then takes it back, then folds it in his lap again.
I'm only here for the night.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: The night is long.
units.name: ARNE

units.text: He lays the knife on the cloth.
It points directly at her.
She looks at it.
Then at him.
Then she picks up her fork and, very carefully, begins to eat.
